The main takeaway from our work is that
the presence of a high level of PA activity does not necessarily correlate with the metastatic phenotype of a given tumour.
the metastatic potential of a tumor cell is not related to the presence of PA, and that the presence of PA in the primary tumor may be related to its role in the modulation of the fibrin network.
